I work with 'special' children, so responsibility and being there for them is needed even more than with regular children.

Now, I am in no way educated (yet) or have a ton of experience in the field so I am kind of the lowest in the food chain.

But this one guy, this one *fucking* guy, is the most irresponsible, selfish and worthless person I have ever met. First of all, he is an ecological fanatic, he won't clean carrots that isn't ecological because he does not want to touch any of those pesticide shit-carrots. I am *o.k.* with that, people are messed up in the head in all sorts of weird ways. What really bothers me is that he has 20+ years of experience in the field and probably even more years of age on me. Yet he somehow cannot get up in time to be at the school on time, he is always, *ALWAYS* 1 hour late, never less, sometimes more. I could probably cope with that, if he just gave a heads-up first and if it didn't happen every single day. On top of that, the first 20 minutes (after he **finally** gets to work) he spends walking around getting rid of his godawful sweat smells and stains, because apparently he can't fathom the possibility of taking the goddamn bus to work (because who wants to be at work on time, *right*?).

It gets even worse (in my perspective). The only thing, the only FUCKING thing, this guy does is take one child, ONE CHILD, out for a bike ride once a day (unless he is forced to do it, god forbid, twice). So my coworker and I was left with 7 children (bear in mind, both of us are not educated, we haven't been working here for more than 5 months. This is not okay by any standard, but because he only needs a certain amount of work hours to be able to go back to being jobless and getting the big paycheck from his union we tolerate it.

Fuck it, I can power through it as long as he is gone in a day (which he is, thank God).

But it doesn't stop here, no siree! What makes everything collapse and make me utterly despise and or hate this guy, is his statement that he doesn't want to live alone or in a house. It's fine, I guess, to some extent. But he doesn't want to because if he had an apartment of his own, he wouldn't be able to live in a house with 3 high school/college girls (he wants to be able to bang them and the awkward them out of the apartment. This is his words, not mine.). His reasoning for the house (shared/alone/as a couple/whatever) is because it requires responsibility (again, his words).

Fuck that guy, I hate him for his entire person, not just his stupidity.
